name: AlphaFold and ESMFold benchmark on PDB structures released 2022 to 2024
description: Independent benchmark of AlphaFold2, AlphaFold3 and ESMFold on non-redundant PDB entries released between 2022 and 2024 whose sequences have no close homologue among pre-2022 structures.

attributes.task: Predict monomeric and dimeric protein structures from sequence
attributes.scope_note: Targets are PDB entries from 2022 to 2024 with sequence identity below 40% or query coverage below 70% against structures released up to 31 December 2021; CD-HIT at 90% identity removed redundancy and chains shorter than 20 or longer than 2700 residues were excluded.
attributes.source_locator: Materials and methods, 'Collection of benchmarking datasets and structure selection criteria'; Tables 1 and 2
limitations: Classification thresholds are the authors' own (RMSD and LDDT for monomers, DockQ for dimers).
